acquisition: Reuse of creator-provided free archives previously acquired in this task; no paid content, signup-only library, or third-party redistribution. Creator pages and included licenses rechecked for this performance set.
derived: sample-source.mjs evaluates original TRS keys into source-samples.json without coordinate conversion. Original pose endpoints are preserved.
avatar-studio/scripts/retarget-performances.mjs reflects X for target handedness and uses the locomotion rest-vector calibration per source rig.
Equipment variations uniformly retime and optionally reverse the entire authored PickUp clip; two-handed grip fitting is a runtime adaptation.
Grip/release markers use the sampled minimum original right-wrist height at source time 0.56666666 seconds. These are application annotations, not creator-authored event tracks.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Left-hand pickup crosses the torso more than the chosen KayKit right-hand pickup.
Actual hand paths reveal a one-handed lid action, not a native two-handed draw.
Magic raise is a one-hand overhead flourish; reload assumes an already-held ranged weapon. Neither is a generic two-hand draw.

limitations: The inspected free packs contain no named Equip/Unequip or general two-hand pickup. Native two-hand draw/stow must not be claimed.
The opposite one-hand variant requires runtime mirroring.
Item carrier clearance, second-hand IK, interruption, and one-shot/loop policies belong to the runtime and are independently tested there.
Raw source mannequins and unused archive clips are development references, not browser runtime downloads.
